<script lang="ts">
import type { Variants } from 'motion-v'

export type PowerProps = IconProps<keyof typeof animations>;

      animate: {

defineOptions({ name: 'Power', inheritAttrs: false })

    <motion.svg
      :width="size"
      :height="size"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      :stroke-width="2"
      stroke-linecap="round"
      stroke-linejoin="round"
      v-bind="attrs"
    >
      <motion.path
        d="M12 2v10"
